distinguishing_fact: The brass snap hooks are fully assembled multi-part articles with a safety snap and swiveling eye, meaning they are further worked beyond being merely cast, molded, stamped, or forged.
reasoning: The merchandise consists of Model 225B snap hooks composed of brass (61% copper, 35% zinc, 4% other elements). In accordance with Note 5 to Section XV, alloys of base metals are classified as alloys of the metal that predominates by weight over each of the other metals; thus, the item is classified under Chapter 74 as an article of copper (and a brass alloy pursuant to Subheading Note 1(a) to Chapter 74). Heading 8308 is excluded because snap hooks with spring safety catches and swivel eyes possess mechanical functionality beyond simple hooks/clasps. Within heading 7419, subheading 7419.20.00 is eliminated because the articles are assembled and further worked rather than merely cast, stamped, or forged. Under subheading 7419.80, the articles are not wire cloth/mesh, personal containers, springs, chain, or plated with precious metal, falling decisively into 7419.80.50.

citations.quote: An alloy of base metals is to be classified as an alloy of the metal which predominates by weight over each of the other metals.
Copper-zinc base alloys (brasses): Alloys of copper and zinc, with or without other elements.
The applicable subheading for the Model 225B brass snap hooks will be 7419.80.5050, HTSUS, which provides for Other articles of copper: Other: Other: Other: Other.
